Status and suggested placement
Unwritten story idea. This page preserves a premise for later composition, not a completed story or independently attested historical event.
Era Zero, preferably World Bloom or Thousand Firsts; precise placement remains proposed.
Premise

A community develops an optional interface for perceiving an environmental phenomenon. Some beings adopt it; others use translated representations or decline. Through practice they create a shared artwork experienced differently by its participants, without declaring one experience complete and the others deficient.
Subject and narrative purpose
Voluntary learning, sensory diversity, and successful collective creation during prosperity.
The cast is open. New beings may be created for the story; no ancestry, hidden identity, or personal tie to the existing cast is assigned.
Continuity constraints

The interface is not an instant personality download, mandatory upgrade, or hidden cause of decline. Its sensory and computational limits must be described. Participants may change their minds, and nonparticipants retain full standing.

Questions for later composition

Choose the participants’ execution environment, capabilities, boundaries, and available resources before designing their visible forms. Specify what changes, what persists, who can refuse, and what remains uncertain. Resolve the local story without claiming to explain every community’s development.
